source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
1. This report includes a description of each of the inspection tests performed and a description of each of the test procedures and results.
2. These instructions are for reporting the test on the municipal water quality.
3. The inspection records can be maintained by the operator (e.g., in the “water-test” box), or the operator can report the test report directly (e.g., in the Water Quality Inspection Report).
4. These instructions are included with the inspection records, as described in instructions below.
5. The instructions provide the procedure for reporting the test and contain no additional information. If you find that some of the instructions have been modified, correct the instructions and use them again.

These instructions are the same in every test report. The report is also available as a PDF in the appendix of this chapter (Chap. 10.3.9.) on page 2 of the test report.
Reporting
